issues.description: The solution's assembleBookstore function is declared to return Void but actually returns a Bookstore and is used by main as if it returns a Bookstore. The template (commented signature) and the problem description expect assembleBookstore to produce and return a Bookstore. This mismatch will cause a compile-time error and prevents students from following the intended flow where main receives a Bookstore from assembleBookstore.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the assembleBookstore function signature in the solution to return a Bookstore (private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore) and ensure it returns the constructed Bookstore. Alternatively, adjust main to not expect a return value, but the intended fix is to make assembleBookstore return Bookstore to match the template and problem requirements.
